note: APTR-11. The complete key surface of the Aperture BFF, by NAME. This file contains no values, no addresses and no credentials, and it never will: a `default` is a behavioural default (a number, a boolean, a media-type allowlist), and a secret entry carries no `default`, no `type` and no `example` at all. A test in crates/lumina-core/src/aperture/config.rs compares this file against the key set the code actually reads, in BOTH directions, including each key's kind, type, rendered default and purpose. The Aperture repo carries a copy at contracts/aperture-config-v1.json, against which docs/CONFIGURATION.md and .env.example are checked. Keeping the two copies identical is a review step, not a gated one — see the module doc.

keys.name: APERTURE_SESSION_TTL_SECS
keys.purpose: Session lifetime before refresh, in seconds

keys.name: APERTURE_AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN
keys.purpose: Auth attempts per minute per source

keys.name: APERTURE_STREAM_MAX_IDLE_SECS
keys.purpose: Idle stream reaped after, in seconds

keys.name: APERTURE_STREAM_RESUME_WINDOW_SECS
keys.purpose: How long a stream may be resumed by event id, in seconds

keys.name: APERTURE_TURN_CANCEL_GRACE_SECS
keys.purpose: Grace window after a turn's last subscriber leaves before it is cancelled, in seconds

keys.name: APERTURE_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES
keys.purpose: Per-file attachment size ceiling, in bytes

keys.name: APERTURE_UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES
keys.default: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif, application/pdf, text/plain, text/markdown
keys.purpose: Permitted attachment content types, as an allowlist

keys.name: APERTURE_CONTEXT_RETENTION_SECS
keys.purpose: How long context-bus entries are retained, in seconds

keys.name: APERTURE_CONTEXT_ENABLED
keys.purpose: Master switch for the context bus

keys.name: APERTURE_SECRET_CACHE_TTL_SECS
keys.purpose: How long a cached secret stays usable when the secret backend is unreachable, in seconds
